correctness.rationale: The logarithmic derivative is reconstructed directly from the three positive factors of the source density. For \(\alpha>0\) its signs are positive at the far left, negative at zero, uniformly positive at \(x=2\), and negative at the far right. The exact bound on the parameter-dependent term is \((1-\sqrt2)/2\), so \(q_\alpha(2)>(37-11\sqrt2)/22>0\). Continuity and analyticity force two distinct positive-to-negative crossings, hence two strict local maxima. Reflection handles \(\alpha<0\) and evenness handles \(\alpha=0\).
